title: Metagenomic analysis of sludge microbial communities during thiocyanate-mediated autotrophic denitrification
description: This project investigates the metagenomic profiles of sludge microbial communities during thiocyanate-mediated autotrophic denitrification. Sludge samples were collected from batch experiments under different nitrate-to-thiocyanate conditions. The metagenomic data were used to characterize microbial functional potential related to thiocyanate degradation, sulfur oxidation, nitrogen transformation, and carbon fixation.
